# NEXUS//SIGNALS — Worklog

Project: Full redesign → "NEXUS//SIGNALS" — AI crypto trading signal command terminal.
Stack: Next.js 16 App Router + TS + Tailwind 4 + shadcn/ui + Prisma/SQLite + TanStack Query + Zustand + Framer Motion + Recharts.
Design: Cyber-Terminal × Neo-Brutalism Bento × Dark Glassmorphism. Palette: neon mint #00ffa3 (primary), violet #b26bff, magenta #ff4ecd, amber #ffb347, danger #ff4d5e, cyan #45f0df. Fonts: Space Grotesk (display), JetBrains Mono (terminal). Always dark.

---

Task ID: 1 + 2
Agent: main (Z.ai Code)
Task: Database architecture + backend engine + APIs

Work Log:
- Created prisma/schema.prisma: Signal (entry/zone, tp1-3, sl, leverage, margin, confidence, RR, timeframe, strategy, status, pnl, ttl, expiresAt, analysis, tags), SignalEvent (typed feed), MarketAsset (price/sparkline JSON/volume), PricePoint (48h history). db:push OK.
- prisma/seed.ts: 10 assets, 40 signals (34 resolved across 7d + 6 active), 76 events, 480 price points. Seeded OK.
- src/lib/engine.ts: tick() throttled 3.5s — random-walk prices, sparkline update, TP1/TP2/TP3/SL/TTL resolution with events, auto-spawn signals (max 5 active), flavor terminal events.
- src/lib/stats.ts: buildStats() — winRate, pnlUSD (margin*pnl%), equity curve by day, bySymbol/Timeframe/Strategy, confidence buckets, streak, best/worst.
- src/lib/format.ts + src/lib/api-types.ts: shared DTOs & formatters (client-safe).
- APIs: GET /api/pulse (tick+snapshot: market, signals, events, stats), GET/POST /api/signals, GET/PATCH /api/signals/[id] (close), GET /api/events, POST /api/ai/chat + POST /api/ai/analyze (z-ai-web-dev-sdk LLM, server-only, fallback if offline).
- Verified via curl: /api/pulse and /api/signals return live data. Engine ticking.

Stage Summary:
- Backend fully operational. Signal DTO shape: see src/lib/api-types.ts (SignalDTO, PulseSnapshot, PlatformStats).

Project: Full redesign → "NEXUS//SIGNALS" — AI crypto trading signal command terminal.
Stack: Next.js 16 App Router + TS + Tailwind 4 + shadcn/ui + Prisma/SQLite + TanStack Query + Zustand + Framer Motion + Recharts.
Design: Cyber-Terminal × Neo-Brutalism Bento × Dark Glassmorphism. Palette: neon mint #00ffa3 (primary), violet #b26bff, magenta #ff4ecd, amber #ffb347, danger #ff4d5e, cyan #45f0df. Fonts: Space Grotesk (display), JetBrains Mono (terminal). Always dark.

Task ID: 1 + 2
Agent: main (Z.ai Code)
Task: Database architecture + backend engine + APIs

Work Log:
- Created prisma/schema.prisma: Signal (entry/zone, tp1-3, sl, leverage, margin, confidence, RR, timeframe, strategy, status, pnl, ttl, expiresAt, analysis, tags), SignalEvent (typed feed), MarketAsset (price/sparkline JSON/volume), PricePoint (48h history). db:push OK.
- prisma/seed.ts: 10 assets, 40 signals (34 resolved across 7d + 6 active), 76 events, 480 price points. Seeded OK.
- src/lib/engine.ts: tick() throttled 3.5s — random-walk prices, sparkline update, TP1/TP2/TP3/SL/TTL resolution with events, auto-spawn signals (max 5 active), flavor terminal events.
- src/lib/stats.ts: buildStats() — winRate, pnlUSD (margin*pnl%), equity curve by day, bySymbol/Timeframe/Strategy, confidence buckets, streak, best/worst.
- src/lib/format.ts + src/lib/api-types.ts: shared DTOs & formatters (client-safe).
- APIs: GET /api/pulse (tick+snapshot: market, signals, events, stats), GET/POST /api/signals, GET/PATCH /api/signals/[id] (close), GET /api/events, POST /api/ai/chat + POST /api/ai/analyze (z-ai-web-dev-sdk LLM, server-only, fallback if offline).
- Verified via curl: /api/pulse and /api/signals return live data. Engine ticking.

Task ID: RESTORE-0909-SNAPSHOT (POST-MORTEM + CLEAN SWAP — converged)
Agent: main
Task: Root-cause the "database disk image is malformed" corruption found minutes after the restore swap, and re-install a provably-clean merged DB.

Work Log:
- SYMPTOM: pulse route 500s with SqliteError extended_code 11 (SQLITE_CORRUPT) on signal/signalEvent reads; PRAGMA integrity_check → "Page 3083-3182: never used" (file ~100 pages larger than the header page-count — a torn/extended-without-commit signature), queries touching those pages failed while the engine tick kept writing to fresh pages.
- ROOT-CAUSE: NOT the snapshot (re-decrypt + integrity_check on the pristine snapshot DB → ok) and NOT the merge logic (re-run on clean sources → ok). The corruption was introduced in swap window #1: the 2GB-heap next-server had not fully exited when the DB file was replaced (pkill + sleep 2 was insufficient), leaving a writer whose stale page-cache/header state hit the new file. Lesson encoded in scripts/restore-0909-swap2.sh: pgrep-wait until process death (up to 20s + SIGKILL fallback) BEFORE any DB install.
- CLEAN REBUILD PIPELINE (all sources integrity-gated): re-decrypt .enc (iter 200000) → base.db OK → donor recovered from the safety tar pre-merge-tree-0909.tar.gz → donor.db OK → restore-0909-merge.py (env-parametrized SNAP_DB/DONOR_DB/OUT_DB; 13 signals, 3,088 events, 103,666 PPs, 30 settings, FK clean) → VACUUM → integrity OK → swap2 with process-death wait → dev-up v8.1 → pulse 200.
- 60s RUNTIME SOAK: integrity_check OK again after a minute of live engine writes (events grew 3088→3103, PP 103,666→103,694) — corruption did NOT recur; swap-window theory confirmed.
- FINAL VERIFY: feed LIVE (binance, 216ms, 0 consecutive failures — the earlier STALE badge was just the poller warming up post-restart), 28 market rows, BTC ~$78.5K; relay armed+chatResolved (sent 6 failed 0); browser: page renders, zero console errors, screenshot scripts/restore-0909-final.png.

# NEXUS//SIGNALS — Worklog

Project: Full redesign → "NEXUS//SIGNALS" — AI crypto trading signal command terminal.
Stack: Next.js 16 App Router + TS + Tailwind 4 + shadcn/ui + Prisma/SQLite + TanStack Query + Zustand + Framer Motion + Recharts.
Design: Cyber-Terminal × Neo-Brutalism Bento × Dark Glassmorphism. Palette: neon mint #00ffa3 (primary), violet #b26bff, magenta #ff4ecd, amber #ffb347, danger #ff4d5e, cyan #45f0df. Fonts: Space Grotesk (display), JetBrains Mono (terminal). Always dark.

---

Task ID: 1 + 2
Agent: main (Z.ai Code)
Task: Database architecture + backend engine + APIs

Work Log:
- Created prisma/schema.prisma: Signal (entry/zone, tp1-3, sl, leverage, margin, confidence, RR, timeframe, strategy, status, pnl, ttl, expiresAt, analysis, tags), SignalEvent (typed feed), MarketAsset (price/sparkline JSON/volume), PricePoint (48h history). db:push OK.
- prisma/seed.ts: 10 assets, 40 signals (34 resolved across 7d + 6 active), 76 events, 480 price points. Seeded OK.
- src/lib/engine.ts: tick() throttled 3.5s — random-walk prices, sparkline update, TP1/TP2/TP3/SL/TTL resolution with events, auto-spawn signals (max 5 active), flavor terminal events.
- src/lib/stats.ts: buildStats() — winRate, pnlUSD (margin*pnl%), equity curve by day, bySymbol/Timeframe/Strategy, confidence buckets, streak, best/worst.
- src/lib/format.ts + src/lib/api-types.ts: shared DTOs & formatters (client-safe).
- APIs: GET /api/pulse (tick+snapshot: market, signals, events, stats), GET/POST /api/signals, GET/PATCH /api/signals/[id] (close), GET /api/events, POST /api/ai/chat + POST /api/ai/analyze (z-ai-web-dev-sdk LLM, server-only, fallback if offline).
- Verified via curl: /api/pulse and /api/signals return live data. Engine ticking.

Stage Summary:
- Backend fully operational. Signal DTO shape: see src/lib/api-types.ts (SignalDTO, PulseSnapshot, PlatformStats).

- CONTEXT: user asked (1) what the signal engine strategy is based on, (2) difference vs their old project, (3) live data connection. Prior engine = random-walk prices + random strategy labels (cosmetic). Binance REST verified reachable from sandbox (curl 200).
- NEW src/lib/indicators.ts — pure quant library: SMA/EMA, Wilder RSI(14), MACD(12,26,9) w/ prevHist expansion flag, Wilder ATR(14), Bollinger(20,2) %B, 20-bar swing levels, IndicatorSnapshot, and scoreConfluence(): weighted 6-factor voting (EMA stack ±25, MACD ±9+6, RSI ±15/mean-revert ±10, 20-bar breakout ±20, Bollinger extremes ±8/±5, volume>1.4x +8 leading side) → score -100..+100, direction, strategy classification (BREAKOUT/MEAN-REVERT/AI-SWING/MOMENTUM/AI-SCALP from factor fingerprint), confidence 55..96 = 55+0.42|score|+volBonus, tags.
- NEW src/lib/market-feed.ts (server-only) — Binance REST client w/ dual-host failover (api.binance.com + data-api.binance.vision), 6.5s AbortController timeout, batched /ticker/24hr (1 call for all 10 symbols), klines cache (TTL 55s), ticker cache, status tracking {source LIVE|STALE|SIMULATED, lastOkAt, latencyMs, consecutiveFailures, host}; resilience ladder: LIVE → STALE (≤5min grace) → SIM drift.

Lesson encoded in scripts/restore-0909-swap2.sh: pgrep-wait until process death (up to 20s + SIGKILL fallback) BEFORE any DB install.
- CLEAN REBUILD PIPELINE (all sources integrity-gated): re-decrypt .enc (iter 200000) → base.db OK → donor recovered from the safety tar pre-merge-tree-0909.tar.gz → donor.db OK → restore-0909-merge.py (env-parametrized SNAP_DB/DONOR_DB/OUT_DB; 13 signals, 3,088 events, 103,666 PPs, 30 settings, FK clean) → VACUUM → integrity OK → swap2 with process-death wait → dev-up v8.1 → pulse 200.
